label: Agent
comment: An agent (person, organization, group, software, etc.) that can act in the world.

label: Person
comment: A person known in the FOAF sense — a human being.

label: Group
comment: A collection of individual agents, treated as a unit.

label: Project
comment: A project, to which people or organizations can be related.

label: Document
comment: A document, including web pages, PDFs, reports, and any information artifact.

label: OnlineAccount
comment: An online account held by an agent.

label: PersonalProfileDocument
comment: A personal profile document, such as a FOAF file describing a person.

label: LabelProperty
comment: A kind of property used to label things in the FOAF vocabulary.
